```{r library}
library(here)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
```
others data
```{r set up file path(relative)}
rm(list = ls())
wd <- "analysis/pnwandmore/data/other_treerings/direct_searching/others/doi_10_5061_dryad_k5k9074__v20190226/Raw_Ring_Widths_012118/Raw_Ring_Widths_012118"
wo <- 'analysis/pnwandmore/input/other_tree_rings/direct_searching/others'
wl <- "analysis/pnwandmore/data/other_treerings/direct_searching/others/doi_10_5061_dryad_k5k9074__v20190226/Tree_Info_BAI_012118/Tree_Info_BAI_012118"
```

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
rawRingDatas <- list.files(here(wd),pattern="avgRingWidth.*",recursive=TRUE,full.names=FALSE)
```

```{r data cleaning}
for (d in 1:length(rawRingDatas)) {
  df_name <- rawRingDatas[d]
  title <- paste0(substr(df_name,1,2),"_",substr(df_name,4,7))
  
  treeinfofile <- list.files(here(wl),pattern=paste0(title,"_treeinfobai",".*\\.csv$"),full.names=FALSE)[1]
  
  
  rawRingData <- read.csv(here(wd,df_name))
  treeinfo <- read.csv(here(wl,treeinfofile)) %>%
    select(Tag,Lat,Long)
  
  rawRingData_long <- rawRingData %>%
  select(-X)%>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "years",
    names_prefix = "X",
    values_to = "Ring_width(mm)") %>%
  select(-Species,-Elev) %>%
    left_join(treeinfo,by="Tag")

  head(rawRingData_long)
  write.csv(rawRingData_long,here(wo,df_name))
}
```


Alberta data
```{r directory} 
alwd <- "analysis/pnwandmore/data/other_treerings/direct_searching/Alberta/dataCite/RawtreeRing/whiteSpruce1983-2016/treering_width.csv"
alwo <- 'analysis/pnwandmore/input/other_tree_rings/direct_searching/Alberta'
```

```{r data input}
alrrd <- read.csv(here(alwd))
```

```{r cleaning and saving}
alrrd <- alrrd %>%
  select(id,year,trw,Latitude,Longitude)%>%
  rename("Ring_width(mm)" = trw,
         Lat = Latitude,
         Long = Longitude,
         Tag = id,
         years = year)

write.csv(alrrd,here(alwo,"treering_width.csv"))
```

Arizona datasearch
```{r directory}
arw <- "analysis/pnwandmore/data/other_treerings/direct_searching/Arizona/datasearch/rawTreeRing/bog_tree/bog_tree_ring_data.txt"
arwo <- 'analysis/pnwandmore/input/other_tree_rings/direct_searching/Arizona'
```

```{r data cleaning}
Lat <- tibble(Lat = 64.6408)
Long <- tibble(Long = 	-148.3334833)
arrrd <- read.table(here(arw),sep="\t",skip = 2,col.names = c("years","Tag","Tree location","Ring_width","Temperature (ºC, Growing Season: May, June, July, Aug)","Precipitation (mm, Growing Season: May, June, July, Aug)")) %>%
  select(years,Tag,Ring_width)%>%
  rename("Ring_width(mm)"=Ring_width)%>%
  bind_cols(Lat,Long)

write.csv(arrrd,here(arwo,"bog_tree_ring_data.csv"))
```
